| --- | --- |
| $12$ | $?$ |
| $20$ | $40$ |

What number is missing from the ratio table?
question.worked_solution:
We start with the ratio $4:8$ and write it as a fraction:

$$
\frac{4}{8}
$$

So the numerator represents the left-hand entry ($4$), and the denominator represents the right-hand entry ($8$).

We can make a numerator of $12$ by multiplying the numerator and denominator by $3$:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{4\times 3}{8\times 3} & =\frac{12}{24}\end{aligned}
$$

We add this to our ratio table:

| $4$ | $8$ |
| --- | --- |
| $12$ | $24$ |
| $20$ | $40$ |

$$

$$

So, the missing number is $24.$
